title: Typography
slide_intent: Connect the shape of letters to the subject they describe because readers perceive character before they finish reading the message.
strategic_value: Linking rounded letterforms to food can give Burger King’s written messages an appetizing identity without adding a food photograph.
demonstration: A short left-hand label accompanies a larger statement that links irreverent typography to natural, organic food shapes.
practical_value: Judge type choices against the stated food-shape rationale rather than treating the font as a neutral carrier.

content_islands.name: Topic label
content_islands.spec: Place the small Typography label in the left column.

content_islands.name: Rationale statement
content_islands.spec: Set the large brown paragraph in the upper-right area of the cream page.

reference_purposes.Intent: The paragraph explicitly says the typography evokes natural, organic food shapes and aims to appear delicious.
reference_purposes.Expression: The statement uses the rounded proprietary face it describes.
